notes: Blue upper plate and cart crop rules require this capture arrangement; new plant geometry and image count are not hardcoded.
Cart underside repair infers a flat bottom and four protected wheel envelopes; inspect synthetic geometry. Disable cart_underside.enabled for other carts.
Robot base layout and nozzle are virtual calibrated placeholders, not real robot registration.
Coordinated motion selects balanced use of five arm joints within explicit contact/time budgets; the gripper stays closed. It is not a claim of global minimum contact.
The user-selected default is coordinated motion. Natural and demonstration refinements remain optional and are disabled in this pipeline configuration.
No valid target/path or failed dynamics means a failed run, never a success marker.
